primary_task: Implement a payment-gateway integration (code, webhooks, tests) in the repository.

requirements.name: Read/Write/Edit/Bash
requirements.basis: bash: run shell commands on Linux x86_64: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads), build, test, run CLIs and scripts, git, gh, start and stop local servers inside the session

requirements.name: payment gateway API credentials
requirements.basis: lacks: accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, model hubs, app stores, email delivery, payment)

requirements.name: payment gateway hosts
requirements.basis: lacks: network access to hosts outside the egress allow-list: only PyPI, npm, GitHub, Ubuntu apt archives, NuGet and the Go module proxy are open; other hosts are refused

notes: Code can be written and tested against mocks. If live or sandbox gateway calls are required, the verdict would be BLOCKED on credential and egress. The progress-tracking JSON is illustrative.
